title: Microbiome Analysis of Alder Nodules and Rhizosphere Soil Found in New Hampshire
description: A field survey of the microbial community found associated with alder nodules and the rhizosphere soil found at five different locations in New Hampshire over several years. Both prokaryotic and fungal communities were profiled during different seasons.
